notes: GRID FROZEN per interfaces §2: origin=bbox min corner rounded to 3 dp; dlat=cell_km/111.32; dlon=cell_km/(111.32*cos(radians(bbox-center lat))); center=origin+((ix+0.5)*dlon,(iy+0.5)*dlat); cell_id=f'{area_code}:{ix}_{iy}'; keep iff CENTER passes point_in_geometry; sorted by (iy, ix).

Candidate index range = [floor((west-origin_lon)/dlon) .. floor((east-origin_lon)/dlon)] x same for lat; may include one extra edge cell whose center lies just past the bbox — it is outside the polygon (polygon subset of bbox) and is rejected, so coverage is never under-counted. Indices may be negative when the rounded origin nudges past the bbox edge (covered by test_plan_origin_rounds_up).
